description: P5.4 Tool/MCP server manager (Section 8.3) AND P5.5 Agent config editor (Section 8.4), built together because the agent editor's DefaultRoutePicker reuses the ProviderModelPicker from FEAT-002 and its AllowedToolsSelector consumes the same MCP servers/tools data the tool manager owns (state/tools.ts). Depends on FEAT-001 (MCP CRUD + persona commands + tools/personas stores) and FEAT-002 (reusable ProviderModelPicker).
steps: TOOL MANAGER (src/features/tool-manager/): ServerList (lists configured MCP servers from state/tools.ts with status badges from per-server McpConnectionState; enable/disable toggle -> setMcpEnabled; remove -> removeMcpServer), ServerForm (create/edit; transport selector stdio { command, args[], env: [key,value][] } OR httpSse { url, headers: [key,value][] }; submit -> addMcpServer/updateMcpServer with the McpServerInput shape from FEAT-001), ToolInspector (per-server discovered tools + schemas from refreshMcpTools/store tool lists), PermissionModeControl (Ask/Allow/Deny per server, and per-tool overrides if FEAT-001 exposed them -> setToolPermission), ConnectionHealth (renders connection state + last mcp_error).

TOOL MANAGER wiring: consume mcp_state_changed (update per-server connection state + tool list) and mcp_error (surface in ConnectionHealth) via the tools store's event function. Refresh via refreshMcpTools. All mutations go through the FEAT-001 commands; the surface never touches transport internals directly.

AGENT EDITOR (src/features/agent-editor/): PersonaList (from state/personas.ts; create/select/delete -> create_persona/delete_persona), PersonaEditor (name, systemPrompt textarea, ModelParameters controls: temperature/maxTokens/topP/frequencyPenalty/presencePenalty/stop), DefaultRoutePicker (REUSE the ProviderModelPicker from FEAT-002 to pick default_route), AllowedToolsSelector (choose which configured MCP servers/tools this persona may use, from the tools store; persona.allowedToolServers is Uuid[] of server ids — the Rust side validates them as UUIDs), RoutingHintControl (RoutingHint union: preferLocal/preferQuality/preferCheap/preferSpeed). Save -> createPersona/updatePersona with PersonaInput.

AGENT EDITOR wiring: consume personas_changed (refresh persona list) via the personas store. assign_persona is invoked from the history/chat resume flow (FEAT-004) but expose an assign action if the editor offers 'use in current conversation'. Validate required fields client-side (non-empty name/systemPrompt) to match the Rust bounds and surface CommandError messages on failure.

TESTS (vitest + RTL): tool manager — ServerForm submit calls addMcpServer with the correct stdio vs httpSse McpServerInput shape; ServerList enable/disable calls setMcpEnabled and remove calls removeMcpServer; feed synthetic mcp_state_changed/mcp_error and assert status badge + ConnectionHealth update; ToolInspector renders tools from the store. agent editor — PersonaEditor save calls createPersona/updatePersona with the full PersonaInput (params + defaultRoute + routingHint + allowedToolServers); DefaultRoutePicker reuse renders the shared picker; personas_changed refreshes the list; AllowedToolsSelector reflects the tools store. Mock invoke + listen.
LOCAL VERIFY: `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` clean; self-audit eslint/tsc; report deferrals.
acceptance_criteria: Tool manager lists servers with live status, adds/edits servers via a transport-aware ServerForm (stdio or httpSse), inspects discovered tools, sets permission modes, and shows connection health; all mutations go through the FEAT-001 MCP commands.
Tool manager updates on mcp_state_changed / mcp_error via the tools store.

Agent editor lists/creates/edits/deletes personas with system prompt, model parameters, default route (reusing ProviderModelPicker), allowed tool servers, and routing hint; saves via create_persona/update_persona; refreshes on personas_changed.
The DefaultRoutePicker reuses the FEAT-002 ProviderModelPicker (built once).
vitest/RTL tests cover rendering, mocked-invoke command calls, and event-driven updates for both surfaces.
verification: Run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend; confirm clean.
Self-audit ESLint/tsc against the configs; report eslint/tsc/vitest deferred to CI.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (frontend-only; no Rust touched). TOOL MANAGER (src/features/tool-manager/): ServerList (lists servers from state/tools.ts with a ConnectionHealth status badge per row driven by the store's per-server connectionState/errors; an enable/disable checkbox -> setEnabled -> set_mcp_enabled; a Remove button -> removeServer -> remove_mcp_server; a per-server PermissionModeControl and an inline ToolInspector; an Edit button that surfaces the row to the parent), ServerForm (create/edit; a stdio|httpSse transport radiogroup; stdio shows command + space-separated args + an env [key,value][] PairEditor, httpSse shows url + a headers [key,value][] PairEditor; a permission-mode select + enabled checkbox; submit builds the exact McpServerInput shape from FEAT-001 and calls store.addServer/updateServer -> add_mcp_server/update_mcp_server; client-side validation requires non-empty name and the transport's required field (stdio command / httpSse url) and surfaces a CommandError via role=alert), ToolInspector (per-server discovered tools with name/description/JSON input schema from the store's tools cache; a Refresh button -> refreshTools -> refresh_mcp_tools), PermissionModeControl (Ask/Allow/Deny radiogroup -> setPermission -> set_tool_permission with toolName:null since FEAT-001 scoped the command to the per-server permission_mode; NO per-tool overrides this phase), ConnectionHealth (renders McpConnectionState label + last mcp_error). A ToolManager container loads servers on mount and hosts the ServerList + ServerForm. mcp_state_changed/mcp_error consumed via the tools store's applyCoreEvent (unchanged from FEAT-001).

AGENT EDITOR (src/features/agent-editor/): PersonaList (from state/personas.ts; New clears the selection, clicking a persona selects it, Delete -> remove -> delete_persona), PersonaEditor (name + systemPrompt textarea; ModelParametersControl for temperature/maxTokens/topP/frequencyPenalty/presencePenalty as numeric inputs + stop as a newline-separated textarea; DefaultRoutePicker; RoutingHintControl; AllowedToolsSelector; Save builds the full PersonaInput and calls store.create/update -> create_persona/update_persona; validates non-empty name/systemPrompt client-side to match Rust bounds and surfaces CommandError via role=alert), DefaultRoutePicker (REUSES the FEAT-002 ProviderModelPicker imported from ../model-selector over the providers store's models, plus a Clear affordance for null/automatic), AllowedToolsSelector (checkbox list of configured MCP servers from the tools store; value is string[] of server UUIDs = persona.allowedToolServers), RoutingHintControl (None + preferLocal/preferQuality/preferCheap/preferSpeed radiogroup). An AgentEditor container loads personas + MCP servers on mount and wires PersonaList <-> PersonaEditor via the store's selectedId (keyed remount on selection change). personas_changed consumed via the personas store's applyCoreEvent.

STORE CHANGES: state/tools.ts gained addServer/updateServer/removeServer/setPermission actions (each forwards to the FEAT-001 command then updates the servers list; removeServer also drops the server's connectionState/tools/errors via an omitKey helper). state/personas.ts gained selectedId + select/create/update/remove actions (create appends+selects, update replaces, remove deletes+clears selection when it was selected). No new IPC commands or TS types were needed; all wrappers (addMcpServer/updateMcpServer/removeMcpServer/setMcpEnabled/setToolPermission/refreshMcpTools/listMcpServers, createPersona/updatePersona/deletePersona/listPersonas) already existed from FEAT-001. ProviderModelPicker REUSED, not rebuilt.

TESTS: features/tool-manager/tool-manager.test.tsx (ServerForm builds the correct stdio vs httpSse McpServerInput and calls add_mcp_server; empty-command validation blocks submit; ServerList enable->set_mcp_enabled + remove->remove_mcp_server; PermissionModeControl->set_tool_permission {toolName:null}; synthetic mcp_state_changed/mcp_error update the badge + ConnectionHealth; ToolInspector renders store tools + Refresh->refresh_mcp_tools) and features/agent-editor/agent-editor.test.tsx (PersonaEditor Create carries the FULL PersonaInput incl. parameters+defaultRoute+routingHint+allowedToolServers; existing persona Save->update_persona; empty name/systemPrompt validation blocks; DefaultRoutePicker renders the reused grouped picker + fires onChange; AllowedToolsSelector reflects the tools store + toggles ids; PersonaList select/delete; personas_changed->list_personas). Extended state/tools.test.ts (add/update/remove/setPermission) and state/personas.test.ts (create/update/remove). All follow the FEAT-001/002 pattern: vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/core') for invoke, vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/event') for listen.

VERIFICATION: `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend PASSES ('All matched files use Prettier code style!'). eslint/tsc/vitest DEFERRED to CI (no node_modules; npm registry 403 offline). Self-audited against eslint.config.js (typescript-eslint recommended): no explicit any; no unused imports/locals; the only unused-positional filter arg (_pair) sits before the used index arg so no-unused-vars 'after-used' does not flag it; react-hooks: useEffect deps exhaustive (ToolManager [load], AgentEditor [loadPersonas, loadServers], PersonaEditor [persona]; store actions are stable refs; PersonaEditor re-seeds via useEffect on persona change and is also key-remounted by the container); switch in tools store applyCoreEvent returns in every arm (no fallthrough). Against tsconfig.json (strict, noUnusedLocals/Parameters): a (route: ManualRoute|null)=>void handler is assignable to ProviderModelPicker's (route: ManualRoute)=>void by param contravariance. All lines <=100 cols; TS unions single-line. Rust untouched.
